description: In which syntactic positions does a declared parameter (PARAMETERS p Long, assigned 2) work, with which Parameters list, rows and error number: WHERE, select list, ORDER BY as a bare key and inside an expression, an IN list, BETWEEN, HAVING, an aggregate argument, a join ON, a scalar subquery, a derived table, a UNION arm, an OR, an EXISTS correlated test, IIf, and CLng? Per temporary QueryDef: Parameters (Name, Type, Direction), the assignment with read-back, then the open (Fields Name/Type/Size, rows, Errors). Runs on a fresh copy of r-sql-13b-main (ACCDB) opened read-only through ACE DAO; each text goes into a temporary QueryDef (CreateQueryDef with an empty name, then DBEngine.Errors).

args.text: PARAMETERS p Long; SELECT x FROM CX WHERE x = p;
p
PARAMETERS p Long; SELECT x, p AS v FROM CX;
p
PARAMETERS p Long; SELECT x FROM CX ORDER BY p;
p
PARAMETERS p Long; SELECT x FROM CX ORDER BY x * p DESC;
p
PARAMETERS p Long; SELECT x FROM CX WHERE x IN (p, 99);
p
PARAMETERS p Long; SELECT x FROM CX WHERE x BETWEEN p AND 5;
p
PARAMETERS p Long; SELECT x FROM CX GROUP BY x HAVING Count(*) >= p - 1;
p
PARAMETERS p Long; SELECT Sum(x * p) AS s FROM CX;
p
PARAMETERS p Long; SELECT x, y FROM CX INNER JOIN CY ON CX.x = p;
p
PARAMETERS p Long; SELECT x FROM CX WHERE x = (SELECT Max(x) FROM CX WHERE x <= p);
p
PARAMETERS p Long; SELECT d.x FROM (SELECT x FROM CX WHERE x <= p) AS d;
p
PARAMETERS p Long; SELECT x FROM CX UNION SELECT p FROM ONE;
p
PARAMETERS p Long; SELECT x FROM CX WHERE x = p OR x = p + 1;
p
PARAMETERS p Long; SELECT x FROM CX WHERE EXISTS (SELECT * FROM CY WHERE CX.x = p);
p
PARAMETERS p Long; SELECT IIf(x = p, 'a', 'b') AS r FROM CX;
p
PARAMETERS p Long; SELECT x FROM CX WHERE x = CLng(p);
p
